scope.relocationWorkload: Fresh checked small application built and executed from relocated installation/output paths containing spaces.

retention: Each child file reproduces the qualified summary.json bytes exactly, including every phase runtime/library/kernel record and frontend/publication observation. Artifact ZIP identities and expiry are recorded separately from tarball and summary identities.

additionalUnchangedQualificationInputsAt.changes: Eight remaining selected-source CI SDK installation blocks use the same bounded cache-aware setup. No matrix workflow, standalone payload, host, checker, compiler source or qualification consumer changed.

artifactRetainedWireDiagnosticEvidence.retention: The complete diagnostic response objects are retained in the changed artifacts. The permanent child summaries retain the passed assurance and qualification-file hash, not a verbatim copy of those response objects.
